bio.text: Michael Eisenhauer, a cardiologist from Great Falls, is running as an independent in 2026 for Montana's 2nd Congressional District.
He grew up in Nebraska and spent about 25 years in the U.S. Army as a physician and health care administrator.
After leaving the military he moved to Wyoming, and about ten years ago came to Great Falls, where he worked as a cardiologist with Benefis Health System.

sources.title: First, but possibly not last, independent candidate enters 2026 Montana elections
